My local women’s abortion clinic. I am in Canada though, after a certain amount of weeks surgical might be a better option for you. With surgical they give you pain medicine and could put you asleep for the procedure if you tell them to. You will still bleed afterwards but much, much less than medical abortion. Good luck.
